boundaries.note: 2. Bundesliga: champion and runner-up up, 3rd into the play-off. Bundesliga: 17th-18th down, 16th into the play-off. Both ties are two legs.
3. Liga: champion and runner-up up, 3rd into the play-off. 2. Bundesliga: 17th-18th down, 16th into the play-off.

Level 4 is 5 regional leagues. Champions of Südwest and West go up directly; the third direct spot rotates yearly and is Nordost's in 2026-27; champions of Bayern and Nord play a two-leg play-off for the 4th place. 3. Liga relegates its bottom 4, each dropping into the Regionalliga of its region.

conflicts.note: Regionalliga Nord (18) and Regionalliga West (18) are missing from our data. The three we carry have correct sizes: Bayern 19, Nordost 18, Südwest 18.
Id reads like 'Nord' but holds Nordost. The newly added Regionalliga Nord uses id RLN; if ids are regenerated, prefer RLNO for Nordost.
Correct, and it implies 38 rounds (380 matches).

notes: Every level is a double round-robin with no split. Play-off ties between divisions are two legs; the higher-division club hosts the second leg. Level 5 (Oberliga) is outside the model: relegation counts from each Regionalliga are not fixed numbers, e.g. Nordost sends down 1 club plus 1 more if a 3. Liga club from the NOFV area is relegated, and Südwest varies with 3. Liga relegations, so no level 4-5 boundary is encoded. The third direct promotion spot from level 4 rotates annually (2026-27: Nordost); a long career sim must rotate it, not hardcode Nordost.
